svg.title: Zenflow ingestion and notifications component diagram: rolling ticker, fetch queues, fetch workers, watchers, materializer, notification rows, SSE pub/sub and push delivery
svg.text: Amber = pull from the university · blue = BullMQ job · orange = DB write / call · grey dashed = pub/sub. Notification rows are written once; SSE and push are separate fan-outs of that row.
INGESTION · rolling schedule → queue → fetch worker → materializer
breaker open → no claims for that upstream
no attempt used) · dispatch by kind
manual job: defer sibling kinds / mark failure
DLU portal + DKHP · one request seam
responses of both clients → pure parsers:
recording always on · fan-out is gated
the ONLY writer of ingested Session rows
(only if every fetch of the run succeeded)
flushDigest: one notification per item type
NOTIFICATIONS · one Notification row → SSE (live) and push (FCM / APNs)
notify() / announce(): publish to pub/sub AND
enqueue push job per provider (fcm, apns)
250 ms timeout · fails open to local emit
GET list · PATCH read / action-taken · DELETE
loads row · skips if allowNotifications off
FcmSender · ApnsSender under breakers fcm / apns
re-reads DB; ignores moved / deleted / past
creates the Notification in ONE transaction
@Cron every 5 min + at boot · kill switch
sweep: arm one delayed job per reminder
